item.title: Senate Advances Bipartisan Permitting Bill That Could Unleash Energy Development With Major Caveats
item.description:
On Monday evening, the Senate moved one step closer to passing the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) with a 73–25 procedural vote to bring the bill to the floor for the full chamber to consider. Sponsored by Sen. Shelley Moore Capito (R–W.Va.), chairwoman of the Senate Environment and Public Works Committee, the 494-page bill would modify the federal permitting process by limiting the scope of environmental reviews and expediting the timeline for project approval.
